questions.prompt: Resource group rg-app was created with metadata location West Europe. An administrator successfully deploys vm-app into rg-app with VM location North Europe. Which pair of locations should the administrator observe?

options.text: rg-app metadata: West Europe; vm-app: North Europe.
options.explanation: The resource-group location stores metadata and does not force contained resources into that region.

options.text: rg-app metadata: West Europe; vm-app: West Europe.
options.explanation: The VM uses its specified North Europe region, rather than inheriting the group metadata region.

options.text: rg-app metadata: North Europe; vm-app: North Europe.
options.explanation: Deploying a resource in another region does not change the group's existing metadata location.

options.text: rg-app metadata: North Europe; vm-app: West Europe.
options.explanation: Neither location is switched by deploying the VM. Group metadata and resource placement are separate.

questions.prompt: An administrator moves a supported VM from rg-old to rg-new in the same subscription. What should they expect from this management move?

options.text: Its resource ID changes while its Azure region stays the same.
options.explanation: Changing groups is not a regional relocation.

options.text: It automatically relocates to rg-new's metadata region.
options.explanation: Group metadata location does not drive physical movement.

options.text: It belongs to both groups afterward.
options.explanation: A resource has one resource-group membership at a time.

options.text: A complete second VM is created and the original remains.
options.explanation: An ARM group move is not a VM cloning operation.

questions.prompt: A study resource group contains a VM, NIC, and storage resources that are no longer needed. What does deleting that group do, assuming no protection blocks deletion?

options.text: Deletes the resources contained in the group.
options.explanation: Group deletion is a lifecycle operation over its contents.

options.text: Removes only the group label and leaves all resources ungrouped.
options.explanation: Azure resources do not become ungrouped through group deletion.

options.text: Moves everything into the subscription's default group.
options.explanation: There is no automatic relocation of all contents to a default group.

options.text: Only stops the VM while retaining every resource.
options.explanation: Stopping compute is a different operation.
